package com.x;
public class BDel extends BAbstractService {
  @Override
  public final Feature getLicenseFeature() {
    return Sys.getLicenseManager().getFeature("vendor", "feature");
  }
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) {
    super.changed(p, cx);
  }
  public void doNothing() {
    return;
  }
}
